procedure: Do not treat a refusal, objection, or No selection as a preference answer. Do not call recovered visual directions original questionnaire answers.
Persist each individual answer immediately using profile.save; read back exact value and revision.
Recovered direct instructions use source_kind=recovered_direct_instruction, answered_at=null, recorded_at=ingestion timestamp and explicit source evidence.
Ask only unresolved user preferences; inspect technical capabilities and files yourself. Never ask the founder to guess them.
Every step reads the current saved profile and records every answer disposition with concrete request/output evidence.
Use visual_pilot scope only for private BASIC/STYLED/LIFESTYLE/graphics. Production retains complete setup gate.
One three-role mini test per actual category; inspect each role before proceeding; preserve defects and failures.
No customer release until actual end-to-end evidence passes.
